Package dev.gmitch215.bytebox.time

Class ZoneHistory

java.lang.Object
dev.gmitch215.bytebox.time.ZoneHistory
public final class ZoneHistory extends Object
A zone's recorded history, read from the timezone database ThreeTen-Backport carries.

Off unless a project asks for it. The platform's own database answers every question about an offset, and IntlZoneRules derives the rest from that, but it cannot list the changes a zone has had or the rules by which they recur, so those refuse. Calling register() installs this as their answer, and the generated entry point does that when the build sets classlib { zoneHistory = true }. A program that never names this class never links it, and the 108 KB database is only copied into the module when it is linked: see ZoneResources.

The file is read here rather than through ThreeTen's own reader, because that reader builds the rules class this package replaces. What is built instead is plain transitions and rules through their public factories, which is all ZoneRules.getTransitions() and getTransitionRules() return.

Only these two answers come from the bundle. Offsets, daylight saving and the search for the next change stay with the platform, so a platform whose database is newer than the bundle can disagree with the history it is shown.

Since:
1.0.3
